description_en: Queries the resources associated with a specified port range list, such as security groups
description_zh: 查询指定端口列表已关联的资源信息，例如，安全组
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-port-range-list-associations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --port-range-list-id prl-2ze97430000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePortRangeListAssociations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the port range list. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 端口列表所在地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of `NextToken` that was returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for paging queries.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this call. If the return value is empty, no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）。当该返回值为空时，表示无更多返回的数据信息

PortRangeListAssociations.description_en: The resources associated with the port range list
PortRangeListAssociations.description_zh: 端口列表已关联的资源信息组成的数组

items.description_en: The information about a resource associated with the port range list
items.description_zh: 端口列表已关联的资源信息集合

ResourceType.description_en: The resource type. Valid value: SecurityGroup
